evidence: https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/dc577a8cbcdec22ae5547615502d63b2051f35a6/test-data/spreadsheet/LogicalFunctionsTestCaseData.xls
https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/is-functions
Apply the type predicate independently to each cell before numeric negation. Binary positional weights distinguish the entire result vector: [0, 1, 1, 0].
Expected authored from independent evidence before running Poirot; independent engine corroboration is required for inclusion.

A proposed plain INDEX observer did not establish array context in Calc and was removed. The retained SUMPRODUCT weighted checksum explicitly supplies array context and already matches every independently authored bit.

All retained expected values were independently recalculated through isolated en-US LibreOffice OOXML snapshots, including after source reconstruction and semantic consolidation. No Poirot result was used to author expected values.

Final hash-bound independent Calc observations: ../evidence/excel-compat-authored-boundaries-libreoffice.json. The suite explicitly selects ExcelDocumentation semantics in both Poirot execution modes.
